evolutionary component-based development is a promising method for developing parallel programs and that the performance-oriented development of such programs can be automated.

the method of evolutionary performance-oriented development of component-based parallel programs is applicable to the development of families of programs with performance goals and that the method and the implementation can be applied to the development of parallel programs for multiple execution environments and multiple program instances.

the method and implementation described in this paper enable evolutionary component-based development and execution of parallel programs to satisfy performance goals on multiple parallel execution environments for multiple program instances.

developing an evolutionary method for component-based parallel program development and an implementation of that method.
the problem of how to evolve parallel/distributed programs to attain performance objectives on multiple execution environments and for multiple program instances.

the method and its implementation is a significant advance in evolutionary development of parallel programs.

this paper describes a method and implementation for evolutionary development of families of programs by composition from components and that the method and implementation are useful for performance-oriented component-based development of parallel/distributed programs.
evolutionary component-oriented development of parallel/distributed programs can be a practical method of development for families of parallel/distributed systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method and an implementation of that method to evolve parallel/distributed programs by composition of parallel/distributed components.

we have developed an evolutionary development method for families of parallel programs and implemented the method in a compiler for the parallel programming language, P3L, which supports integrated parallel/distributed simulation and parallel/distributed execution.
the method is a practical approach to evolutionary performance-oriented development of families of programs to attain performance requirements on multiple execution environments.
The main takeaway from our work is that

performance-oriented evolutionary development of parallel programs can be achieved by composition of components at different levels and abstractions and that performance can be estimated at each stage of realization.
evolutionary performance-oriented component-based development is a viable approach for the development of parallel/distributed programs and that it can be supported by a compiler and runtime system.

the evolutionary performance-oriented development method can be applied to the development of a wide range of parallel programs and that it is a viable alternative to traditional development methods for parallel programs.
